subject: Architecture
title: Mars Habitats: Printing a New Home
description: A quick, practical guide to Mars Habitats: Printing a New Home.

hook.text: NASA ran a contest to design 3D-printed Mars habitats. The winning designs look like alien architecture.

buildup.text: Mars has thin atmosphere, extreme cold, and no magnetic field — buildings must shield against cosmic radiation.

discovery.text: AI Space Factory's winning design uses basalt fiber from Martian rock — stronger than concrete, radiation-blocking.

twist.text: The egg-shaped habitat was also 3D-printed on Earth as a prototype — guests can rent it on Airbnb.

climax.text: SpaceX aims to send the first humans to Mars in the 2030s — architects are already designing their future homes.

punchline.text: The first house on Mars will be printed by a robot. From Martian dirt.

quiz.question: What material does AI Space Factory propose for Mars construction?
options: Basalt fiber made from Martian rock
Ice blocks harvested from the polar caps
